caption: The drawing depicts a central oval-shaped object composed of two distinct parts: the upper portion is colored red and the lower portion is beige with some shaded areas suggesting texture or surface variation. Surrounding this central oval shape are numerous long, narrow, radiating spikes that extend outward in all directions; these spikes are predominantly yellow with some thin details in brown, and vary in length and angle, creating a symmetrical burst pattern. The background is plain and uncolored, focusing attention on the central and radiating elements. There is also a handwritten signature or text in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Aurora, from Behind Saint
